title: M548 Metal Ammunition Containers Bridge Contract
description: The Government intends to award a 12 month bridge contract to Conco, Inc., under the authority of 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(1), as implemented by FAR 6.302 Only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements. This action is for the production and delivery of approximately 9,000 M548 Metal Ammunition Containers, a critical packaging component for small and medium caliber ammunition used in training and combat operations. The bridge contract is necessary to ensure continued production and delivery of these containers until the anticipated follow-on contract is fully implemented. The proposed contract will be a firm-fixed-price 12 month bridge contract that mirrors the scope of work previously performed under the expired Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) Contract W52P1J-20-D-0033 with Conco, Inc. The estimated value of this effort is $616,964.60. The follow-on M548 Metal Ammunition Containers contract was awarded on September 25, 2025, with First Article Testing (FAT) due by June 23, 2026, and deliveries commencing in September 2026. However, immediate container deliveries are required in November 2025, January 2026, and April 2026. Extensive market research conducted on February 22, 2024, identified other potential vendors, but only Conco, Inc. can meet November 2025, January 2026, and April 2026 delivery timelines without unacceptable delays. Other vendors would require FAT and tooling modifications, resulting in a minimum delivery timeline of 12 months. Given Conco, Inc�s long history of successful M548 Metal Ammunition Containers production and the Government's agreement to waive FAT due to historically low risk of failure, it is determined that posting an additional Request for Information (RFI) or sources sought notice would not benefit the Government and would duplicate previous efforts.

title: Non-emergency patient transport services
description:
This tender is addressed to companies whose service offering is focused on S4 patient transports in accordance with the guidelines of the Interverband für Rettungswesen (IVR). An S4 transport is defined as a transport where there is no impairment of vital functions, or where such impairment can be ruled out. Furthermore, it must not be expected that any medical or nursing interventions will be required during transport. Any ongoing long-term therapies already in place, such as oxygen administration, must be continued without interruption during transport whenever required.

The patients to be transported are from a geriatric care environment. Therefore, in addition to professional qualifications, particular emphasis is placed on the social and communication skills of the personnel deployed. Staff are expected to communicate in a calm, respectful, and understandable manner, demonstrate patience, and be confident in interacting with individuals who have neurological impairments such as aphasia, dementia, or orientation disorders.

Bidders must possess the necessary professional expertise, qualified personnel, and the required organisational and operational capabilities. All permits, licences, approvals, and supporting documentation required for the provision of the services must be submitted together with the tender.

description: Die drei Krankenhäuser Aurich, Emden, Norden sollen zu einer Klinik zusammengeführt werden. Geplant ist der Bau eines aufgelösten Komplexes aus mehreren Gebäuden mit den dazugehörigen Verkehrs-, Park- und Freiflächen. Mit der Zentralklinik entsteht ein modernes und zentral zwischen den Städten Aurich, Emden und Norden gelegenes 814-Betten-Haus auf einem 36 Hektar großen Areal in Uthwerdum. Das Baugrundstück befindet sich bei Uthwerdum ein Ortsteil der Gemeinde Südbrookmerland im Landkreis Aurich in Ostfriesland. Die Erschließung des Geländes erfolgt über die südlich angrenzenden Bundesstraßen B72 und B21. Bestandteil der Ausschreibung ist die Errichtung der zentralen Stromversorgungsanlagen zur Sicherstellung und Verteilung der elektrischen Versorgung im Energiepark, sowie in den Gebäuden Versorgungszentrum, Somatik und Zentrum Seelischer Gesundheit. Huollon päivystyshinnan mukainen erillisveloitus voidaan laskuttaa ainoastaan silloin, kun tehtävän hoitaminen edellyttää käyntiä kiinteistöllä työ laskutetaan tarjouslomakkeella ilmoitettujen päivystyshintojen mukaisesti. Talviylläpito kattaa parkkialueiden ja pelastusteiden lumenaurauksen sekä liukkaudentorjunnan. Auraus- ja liukkaudentorjunta käynnistetään olosuhteiden niin edellyttäessä ilman erillistä työtilausta. Toteutunut työaika kirjataan kohde- ja tehtäväkohtaisesti yhdessä tilaajan kanssa sovitulla tavalla.

Für die Gestellung dieser Binnenschiffstransporte sind technisch geeignete Kanalschubboote und Stromschubboote erforderlich, deren Besatzung nachweislich nach der Binnenschiffspersonalverordnung qualifiziert und in der Lage sein muss, die technischen Einrichtungen des Güterschubleichters URSUS zu bedienen. Überdies ist optional die Durchführung der Gasturbinen Transporte im Verbund mit dem Schubschiff ELEKTRA Gegenstand der Leistungsbringung.

title: Brakker, containere og mobile vogner til Nasjonalt Ankomstsenter
description: Utlendingsdirektoratet (UDI/Oppdragsgiver), inviterer til anskaffelse av brakker, containere og mobile vogner til Nasjonalt Ankomstsenter på Råde, Mosseveien 58, 1640 Råde. Formålet med anskaffelsen er å dekke UDI (oppdragsgiver) sitt behov for mobilisering, leie, demobilisering og ev. kjøp av modulbaserte brakker, samt leie av containere og mobile vogner, til Nasjonalt ankomstsenter, for å sikre tilstrekkelig kapasitet til midlertidige innkvarterings- og støttefunksjoner over tid. Det skal inngås kontrakt med én leverandør. Kontrakten består av en Hovedleveranse og opsjoner. Hovedleveranse:Hovedleveransen omfatter leie av totalt 23 brakker/modulenheter, hvor hver brakke/modulenhet skal ha et areal på minimum 24 kvm (BRA). Leveransen består av:20 brakker til bo- og innkvarteringsformål 3 brakker til vakt-/vekterformål, som skal sammenkobles til én modulbasert løsning Brakkene som omfattes av hovedleveransen er ment å dekke et langsiktig behov og skal tilfredsstille relevante krav i TEK17 for det aktuelle bruksformålet. Det legges til grunn leieperioder på inntil åtte (8) år.Opsjon 1 – Øvrig leie:Oppdragsgiver har rett, men ikke plikt, til å leie ytterligere brakker og moduler ved behov. Opsjonen omfatter blant annet:Innkvarteringsbrakker Vekterbrakker Standardmoduler lager- og frysecontainere, mobile vogner, herunder HMS- og sanitærvogner, letthus Brakkene på opsjonen er blant annet tiltenkt benyttet til innkvartering, vakt/vekterformål, administrasjonog øvrige støttefunksjoner. Leieperiodene vil variere og forventes normalt å være fra 6 måneder til 2 år,avhengig av type enhet og oppdragsgivers behov.Opsjon 2 – Kjøp av brakker fra Hovedleveransen: Oppdragsgiver har rett, men ikke plikt, til å kjøpe (utkjøp) brakker som inngår i Hovedleveransen.

title: Rammeavtaler for rørleggertjenester med tilhørende materiell
description: Sandnes kommune har til hensikt å inngå rammeavtaler som dekker oppdragsgivers behov for rørleggertjenester i forbindelse med drift, vedlikehold og rehabiliteringsprosjekter i kommunale bygg, anlegg og boliger. Leverandøren skal som en integrert del av oppdragene også levere det materiell som er nødvendig for å utføre arbeidene. Avtalen omfatter i tillegg levering av rørleggermateriell til enkelte rørleggerarbeider som kommunen utfører i egenregi. Avtalene skal omfatte kommunale bygg, anlegg og boliger hos oppdragsgiver, herunder skoler, barnehager, bo- og aktivitetssenter, syke- og aldershjem, svømme- og idrettshaller, kontorbygg, kulturhus, kommunale utleieboliger, helsestasjoner mv. I tillegg til rørleggertjenester med tilhørende materiell omfatter rammeavtalene i mindre omfang også ingeniørtjenester, herunder rådgivning og prosjektering innen alle områder som omfattes av avtalen, blant annet miljø, bærekraftig energiforsyning og fornybar energi. Leverandøren skal ved behov også kunne påta seg rollen som hovedentreprenør, hovedbedrift, totalentreprenør eller totalunderentreprenør, med ansvar for eventuelle underentreprenører. Forventet oppstart for rammeavtalene er 1. mars 2027. Rammeavtalen er nærmere beskrevet i konkurransegrunnlaget del II – Kontraktsgrunnlaget.

title: Rammeavtale for bemanningstjenester for gravplassene
description: Anskaffelsens formålAnsvaret for gravplassene forvaltes av vel 30 faste ansatte med ulike faglige funksjoner. Avdelingen har både mannlige og kvinnelige ledere. For å rekke over alt arbeidet knyttet til en utvidet sommersesong, slik som bl.a. stell og vedlikehold av grøntanlegg / nyanlegg, annet forefallende arbeid, noe enkelt bruk og vedlikehold av maskinelt utstyr, må det rekrutteres et stort antall månedsverk.Formålet med anskaffelsen er å sikre tilgang til kvalifisert personell i den utvidede sommersesongen. Behovet framkommer av en bemanningsplan som leverandøren skal oppfylle. I tillegg til denne bemanningsplanen har oppdragsgiver et gitt antall tilbakevendende sesongarbeidere. Disse holdes utenfor denne anskaffelsen.

title: 26/6706 Solli habilitering - Totalentreprise
description: Oppdragsgiver / Anskaffelsens formål Oppdragsgiver er Moss Kommunale Eiendomsselskap KF (MKEiendom), som forvalter, drifter og vedlikeholder Moss kommunes eiendomsmasse, herunder byggherreoppgaver ved nybygg og rehabilitering. Formålet med anskaffelsen er å inngå kontrakt om ombygging av eksisterende bygg til nye lokaler for habiliteringstjenesten i Moss kommune. Anskaffelsen gjennomføres som totalentreprise etter NS 8407. Fullstendig beskrivelse fremgår av kravspesifikasjonen. Anskaffelsens anslåtte verdi Anslått verdi er kr 20.000.000 ekskl. mva. Estimatet er ikke bindende for oppdragsgiver. Viktige datoer Tidsrammer for prosessen fremgår av tidsfristene i konkurransen. Tilbudsbefaring holdes fredag 20. november kl. 12:00. Oppmøte: parkeringsplassen ved Øreåshallen, Øreåsveien 9, Moss. Egenbefaring holdes fredag 27. november kl. 09:00-14:00. Byggherre vil ikke være til stede, men bygget vil være åpent i angitt tidsrom. Parkering skal skje ved Øreåshallen, Øreåsveien 9, Moss. Tidspunkter etter tilbudsfrist er foreløpige og kan bli justert. Forlengelse av vedståelsesfristen kan bare skje med leverandørens samtykke. Oppdragsgiver planlegger å åpne tilbud og starte evaluering i uke 1, 2027. Tilbudsbrev Tilbudsbrev skal fylles ut. Eventuelle forbehold og/eller avvik skal fremgå av tilbudsbrevet. Vedlagt mal skal benyttes. eBevis Oppdragsgiver benytter eBevis. Det innhentes blant annet opplysninger om restanser fra Skatteetaten og firmaopplysninger fra Brønnøysundregistrene. Før opplysninger kan hentes inn, må leverandøren samtykke. Leverandøren mottar forespørsel om samtykke fra Altinn ved tilbudsinnlevering i Hyyr. Dersom samtykke ikke gis, må etterspurt dokumentasjon sendes elektronisk via Hyyr. Kontraktsvilkår Se eget dokument «Kontraktsgrunnlag», punkt B. Krav om lønns- og arbeidsvilkår Kontrakten vil inneholde krav om lønns- og arbeidsvilkår, dokumentasjon og sanksjoner i samsvar med forskrift om lønns- og arbeidsvilkår i offentlige kontrakter §§ 5 a-5 d. Krav om utvidet skatteattest Kontrakten vil inneholde krav om at leverandør og eventuelle underleverandører på forespørsel skal levere utvidet skatteattest (RF-1507) gjennom hele kontraktsperioden. Avvisning Reglene om avvisning i FOA del II kapittel 9 kan komme til anvendelse. Leverandør skal fylle ut vedlagt egenerklæring som foreløpig dokumentasjon på at det ikke foreligger avvisningsgrunner, jf. FOA §§ 8-10 bokstav b og 9-5. Skatteattest og kvalifikasjonskrav Leverandøren skal i tilbudsbrevet bekrefte at krav til innbetalte skatter og øvrige kvalifikasjonskrav er oppfylt. Dokumentasjon skal ikke leveres sammen med tilbudet. Oppdragsgiver kan når som helst i konkurransen etterspørre dokumentasjon fra alle deltakere, og vil senest før kontraktstildeling etterspørre dokumentasjon fra leverandøren som er rangert som nummer én. Støtte fra annet foretak Dersom leverandøren støtter seg på andre foretak for å oppfylle tekniske/faglige kvalifikasjonskrav eller krav til økonomisk og finansiell kapasitet, skal dette opplyses i tilbudsbrevet. Dokumentasjon fra slike foretak skal ikke leveres med tilbudet, men kan bli etterspurt senere i konkurransen. Foretak som benyttes for å oppfylle tekniske/faglige kvalifikasjonskrav, må på forespørsel levere forpliktelseserklæring som bekrefter at nødvendige ressurser stilles til rådighet. Foretak som benyttes for å oppfylle krav til økonomisk og finansiell kapasitet, må på forespørsel levere forpliktelseserklæring som viser at foretaket er solidarisk ansvarlig med leverandøren. Vedlagt mal for forpliktelseserklæring oppfordres benyttet. Tilbud fra gruppe Dersom leverandøren består av en gruppe med to eller flere deltakere (arbeidsfellesskap mv.), skal tilbudet signeres av samtlige. Hvert gruppemedlem skal levere skatteattest og oppfylle kravene til organisatorisk og juridisk stilling samt økonomisk og finansiell kapasitet. Gruppen skal samlet oppfylle kravene til tekniske og faglige kvalifikasjoner, eventuelt ved bruk av underleverandører. I tilbudsbrevet skal det bekreftes at kravene er oppfylt. Dokumentasjon skal ikke leveres sammen med tilbudet, men kan bli etterspurt senere. Elektronisk tilbudsinnlevering / Tilbudets utforming Tilbudet skal leveres elektronisk via Hyyr innen tilbudsfristen. Tilbud sendt på annen måte vil bli avvist. Tilbudet skal utformes i samsvar med innleveringssystemet og konkurransegrunnlaget. Besvarelse med vedlegg utgjør leverandørens komplette tilbud. Meddelelse om valg av leverandør og opplysning om karensperiode Meddelelse om valg av leverandør og opplysning om karensperiode sendes berørte leverandører i tråd med FOA § 10-1. Meddelelsen vil inneholde begrunnelse for valget og opplysning om karensperiode etter § 10-2. Dersom oppdragsgiver finner at beslutningen er i strid med forskriften, kan den omgjøres frem til kontrakt er inngått. Avlysning av konkurransen Oppdragsgiver kan avlyse konkurransen med øyeblikkelig virkning dersom det foreligger saklig grunn, jf. FOA § 10-4. MKEiendom forbeholder seg retten til å redusere oppdragets omfang eller forkaste oppdraget av økonomiske eller politiske årsaker.

title: 114-BYM-2026 Entreprenør til Sinsenveien mellom Dag Hammarskjöldsvei og Lørenveien
description: Anskaffelsen omfatter gateoppgradering og fornying av VA-ledninger i Sinsenveien. Prosjektet er et samarbeidsprosjekt mellom Bymiljøetaten (BYM) og Vann- og avløpsetaten (VAV) og utføres derfor som en felles entreprise. BYM er tiltakshaver og byggherre i samarbeidsprosjektet.Prosjektet legger opp til en samhandlingsfase før anleggsoppstart, se kontraktens punkt 26 for nærmere beskrivelse. BYM skal opparbeide Sinsenveien til en attraktiv gate ved å tilrettelegge bedre for gående og syklende. Planområdet strekker seg mellom Dag Hammerskjölds vei i nord til Lørenveien i sør, en strekning på ca. 400 meter. Nordøstre del av gata er nylig utbygd med boligblokker og nytt fortau med trær. Vestsiden av prosjektet grenser til Sinsen hageby med småhusbebyggelse. I dag har Sinsenveien en varierende bredde på ca. 14-16 meter med toveis trafikk og stedvis dårlig tilrettelegging for gående. Sinsenveien skal forbedres med utvidelse av fortau på vestsiden og sørøstre del av gata og bygge opphøyde gangfelt ved alle kryssinger med Lørenveien i sør, samt to i Sinsenveien. Gaten skal sørge for oversiktlig kjøremønster for syklister, kjørende og gående. Det skal etableres sykkelfelt i begge retninger. Der Breisjåveien og Vidsynveien kommer inn på Sinsenveien vil utvidelser av fortauet gjøre gangfeltene tydeligere og tryggere. HC-parkering skal etableres i Breisjåveien. Kabler i luftstrekk skal legges ned i bakken og ny belysning skal opp. Elvia sine kabler skal legges om som en del av prosjektet. Det skal utføres en fornying av de offentlige VA-ledningene som en del av prosjektet. Ny DN 200 mm vannledning legges som erstatning for den eksisterende DN150 mm vannledningen, og det skal utføres separering av eksisterende AF-ledning med henholdsvis ny Ø315 mm overvannsledning og ny Ø250mm spillvannsledning. I utførelsen må eksisterende DN600 vannledning i drift hensyntas, og at det er overgang mellom to trykksoner i området. Det vises til tegninger og beskrivelse. Det skal sikres at gata er tilgjengelig for allmennheten i så stor grad som mulig i anleggsfasen.Det vil være mulig å stenge gaten for gjennomkjøring i fase 1, men kun ett kvartal av gangen for å sikre fremkommelighet og rasjonell anleggsgjennomføring. Kjøring til eiendommer må ivaretas, samt åpen trasé for myke trafikanter forbi anleggsområdet. Merk at det nybyggede fortauet langs nordøstsiden ikke skal benyttes til lagring e.l. da dette fortauet er utenfor anleggsområdet. description: Concours de maîtrise d’oeuvre sur « esquisse + » pour la réhabilitation du Musée d’Archéologie de LAON et ses réserves. Le présent concours est un concours restreint sur « esquisse + » organisé conformément aux dispositions des articles L. 2125-1 2°, R. 2162-15 à R. 2162-26 et R. 2172-1 et suivants du Code de la commande publique. A l’issue de ce concours, le Président de la CAPL pourra passer un marché de maîtrise d’œuvre sans publicité ni mise en concurrence préalables avec le lauréat ou l’un des lauréats du concours, conformément aux dispositions de l’article R. 2122-6 de la commande publique et à la délégation consentie pour la durée du mandat par délibération 6 du 15 avril 2026. Eléments essentiels du programme : Le Maître d’Ouvrage souhaite réaliser un marché pour une mission de maitrise d’œuvre qui porte sur la réhabilitation du Musée d’Archéologie de Laon et ses réserves, en vue de transformer l’établissement en un pôle culturel et touristique majeur pour le Pays de Laon comportant trois objectifs prioritaires : - Protéger et conserver les collections dans de bonnes conditions, avec la création de nouveaux espaces de réserves dans le bâtiment acquis et le réaménagement des espaces existants ; - Repenser le parcours de visite pour le rendre plus innovant, didactique et ludique ; - Renforcer l'attractivité du musée pour en faire un outil touristique majeur, incluant la création de nouveaux espaces d'accueil du public, un espace polyvalent et un espace dédié aux expositions temporaires et en rendant l’ensemble accessible aux personnes à mobilité réduite. Le programme prévoit également l’aménagement paysager des espaces extérieurs. La partie de l’enveloppe financière prévisionnelle affectée aux travaux est de 4 270 000 € HT, dont 950 000 HT affectés à la scénographie du parcours de visite, en date de valeur de septembre 2025.

title: Greece – Diesel fuel – Προμήθεια καυσίμων του Δήμου Νότιας Κέρκυρας
description: Αντικείμενο της σύμβασης είναι η προμήθεια υγρού καυσίμου (πετρέλαιο κίνησης diesel, βενζίνη αμόλυβδη και πετρέλαιο θέρμανσης) και πρόσθετου τύπου AdBlue (διάλυμα ουρίας), προκειμένου ο Δήμος Νότιας Κέρκυρας να καλύψει τις ανάγκες θέρμανσης των σχολικών κτιρίων και παιδικών/βρεφονηπιακών σταθμών που βρίσκονται εντός των διοικητικών ορίων του, καθώς και τις ανάγκες κίνησης των οχημάτων και μηχανημάτων έργου των υπηρεσιών του Δήμου, όπως επίσης και για την λειτουργία τωνδιαφόρων εργαλείων με κινητήρες εσωτερικής καύσης (χορτοκοπτικά, πριόνια κ.λπ.) τα οποία έχουν στην διάθεσή τους οι υπηρεσίες του Δήμου, είναι απαραίτητη η προμήθεια πετρελαίου θέρμανσης, πετρελαίου κίνησης, αμόλυβδης βενζίνης καθώς και υδατικού διαλύματος ουρίας (τύπου AdBlue) για τις ανάγκες των υπηρεσιακών οχημάτων, που είναι εφοδιασμένα με σύστημα επεξεργασίας καυσαερίων Selective Catalytic Reduction (SCR). Προσφορές υποβάλλονται και για τα τέσσερα υπό προμήθεια είδη. Προσφορά οικονομικού φορέα η οποία δεν θα αφορά και τα τέσσερα υπό προμήθεια είδη (καύσιμα και πρόσθετο AdBlue) θα απορρίπτεται ως απαράδεκτη. Η αναθέτουσα αρχή προβαίνει στη συγκεκριμένη ανάθεση χωρίς διαχωρισμό σε τμήματα, καθώς η προμήθεια αφορά το σύνολο των απαιτούμενων καυσίμων και του πρόσθετου AdBlue για την κάλυψη των αναγκών του Δήμου Νότιας Κέρκυρας κατά τα έτη 2027–2028. Η προσφορά πρέπει να περιλαμβάνει και τα τέσσερα είδη, σύμφωνα με τους όρους της παρούσας διακήρυξης και της σχετικής μελέτης

title: Atomically Precise Molecules (APM)
description: Amendment 01: The purpose of this amendment is to extend the required abstract deadline. The Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) is soliciting innovative proposals in the areas of new synthesis techniques for polymeric materials and nonlinear optical (NLO) materials. Proposed research should investigate innovative approaches that enable revolutionary advances in material synthesis with the ability to scale to quantities relevant for application integration, culminating in the development of a prototype demonstration of a revolutionary NLO material integrated into a functional government-provided electro-optic modulator. Specifically excluded is research that primarily results in evolutionary improvements to the existing state of practice, or research that pivots on exceptional claims that cannot be technically justified in the proposal. This includes: � Proposals aiming to employ solely inorganic materials without a polymeric component � Proposals aiming to modify/repurpose existing NLO materials resulting in incremental improvements to the state-of-the-art (SoA)

title: Belgium – Research and development consultancy services – EU Security Sector Governance Facility
description: The contract will provide expertise in the field of Security Sector Governance (SSG) to complement EU's engagement in support to the security sector of partner countries. It will enhance the implementation of the EU SSR Strategic framework (2016) and its revision (2025). The purpose of the contract is to support politically informed and locally owned Security Sector Reform (SSR) processes in partner countries that enhance accountability, inclusivity, and public trust in security forces. This will primarily be achieved through provision of technical expertise. Various activities are foreseen, including deployment of relevant experts to undertake research, analysis and advisory activities, provision of training and capacity-building activities to national authorities and regional/international organisations, information sessions for EU entities, etc.

title: Itäkeskuksen joukkoliikenneterminaalin arkkitehtuurikilpailu
description: Itäkeskuksen joukkoliikenneterminaalin arkkitehtuurikilpailu Pääkaupunkiseudun Kaupunkiliikenne Oy julkaisee arkkitehtuurikilpailua koskevan ilmoituksen Itäkeskuksen joukkoliikenneterminaalin arkkitehtisuunnittelusta Helsingin Joukkoliikenneinfra Oy:n ja Helsingin kaupungin liikenneliikelaitoksen (HKL) puolesta. Korttelialueella on tällä hetkellä Itäkeskuksen metroaseman sisäänkäynti, kaksi pysäköintilaitosta ja näiden kansitasolla bussiterminaali. Helsingin kaupunkistrategian 2025-2029 tavoitteiden mukaisesti Itäkeskusta kehitetään kunnianhimoisesti. Itäkeskuksen joukkoliikenneterminaalin uudistuksessa tavoitteena on luoda sujuvat vaihtoyhteydet eri liikennevälineiden välillä. Joukkoliikenneterminaalin suunnittelussa tavoitellaan viihtyisää, turvallista ja saavutettavaa kokonaisuutta. Hyvällä suunnittelulla halutaan varmistaa, että liikennevälineestä toiseen siirtyminen on helppoa ja sujuvaa ja tarpeelliset palvelut ovat lähellä. Uudistuksen myötä pikaraitiotie PR15 päätepysäkki sijoitetaan osaksi joukkoliikenneterminaalikorttelia. Kilpailun tavoitteena on luoda kaupunkikuvallisesti kiinnostavaa ja alueelle vahvaa identiteettiä luovaa ratkaisua. Kilpailu järjestetään yhteistyössä Helsingin kaupungin ja Suomen arkkitehtiliitto SAFA:n kanssa, liiton yleisesti käyttämien kilpailusääntöjen mukaisesti. Tarkemmat tiedot kilpailuohjelmasta, kilpailun verkkosivuilta. https://cc.tietoa.fi/c/itis-jlt Helsingin kaupungin liikenneliikelaitos ja Helsingin Joukkoliikenneinfra Oy tilaavat arkkitehtuurikilpailun voittaneelta taholta hankkeen pää- ja arkkitehtisuunnittelun, mikäli seuraavat edellytykset täyttyvät: - kilpailun voittajalla, tulevalla sopimuskumppanilla on tekijänoikeudet suunnitelmaan - kilpailun voittaja nimeää vähimmäisvaatimukset täyttävät kaksi henkilöä eli pääsuunnittelijan ja vastuullisen arkkitehtisuunnittelijan, voittaja voi myös itse toimia toisessa em. rooleista - tilaajat ja kilpailun voittaja pääsevät neuvotteluissa yhteisymmärrykseen sopimusehdoista ja suunnittelupalkkiosta (kattohinta ja tuntihinnat). Tehtävä käsittää seuraavien tehtäväluetteloiden mukaiset tehtävät: Hankesuunnittelu tehtäväluetteloiden kohdat B- D, Yleissuunnitelmat ja toteutuksen suunnittelu tehtäväluetteloiden kohdat E-G, Rakentamisen aikaiset ja takuuajan tehtävät tehtäväluetteloiden kohdat H-K. Tehtävä sisältää työturvallisuuslain mukaiset suunnittelijan velvoitteet sekä rakennustyön turvallisuutta koskevan asetuksen VNa 205/2009, 7§ mukaiset velvoitteet. Pääsuunnittelijaa ja vastuullista arkkitehtisuunnittelijaa koskevat vähimmäisvaatimukset: 1) Suunnittelijoilla tulee olla rakentamislain mukainen, oman alansa pätevyystodistus erittäin vaativalta tasolta. 2) Nimettävillä suunnittelijoilla tulee olla kokemusta vastaavan tyyppisestä ja laajuisesta hankkeesta hankkeen eri vaiheissa esimerkiksi matkustajaterminaalin, rautatieaseman, lentokenttäterminaalin, kauppakeskuksen tms. suunnittelusta, jossa on huomioitu suurien asiakas-, matkustaja- tai kävijämäärien hallinta. Kohteen erityislaatuisuuden vuoksi voidaan huomioida myös yli viisi (5) vuotta sitten valmistunut hanke. 3) Suunnittelijoilla tulee olla vähintään hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen suomen kielen taito. Neuvottelut toimeksiantosopimuksesta Neuvottelut aloitetaan viimeistään kolmen (3) viikon kuluttua kilpailun ratkaisemisesta, jolloin neuvotteluihin kutsutun tulee neuvottelujen alkaessa esittää tilaajille pääsuunnittelijan ja vastuullisen arkkitehtisuunnittelijan rooleihin ehdotetut, vähimmäisvaatimukset (1-3) täyttävät henkilöt hyväksyttäväksi. Neuvottelut käydään suomen kielellä ja sopimus laaditaan suomen kielisenä. Voittajan kanssa käydään neuvottelut kolmen (3) kuukauden aikana suunnittelukilpailun voittajan valinnan jälkeen. Tavoitteena tässä ajassa on saada molempien osapuolten hyväksymä näkemys sopimuksen ehdoista ja suunnittelupalkkiosta. Neuvottelujen jälkeen tilaajat tekevät hankintapäätökset toimeksiannosta. Toimeksiantosopimus laaditaan RT 80420 -sopimuspohjaan. Tilaaja laatii osapuolten väliseen neuvotteluun sopimusluonnoksen ja sen ehdot sekä sopimuksen liitteet. Sopimukseen liitetään mm. arkkitehtisuunnittelun tehtäväluettelo ARK18:n (RT 10-103253) ja pääsuunnittelun tehtäväluettelo PS18:n (RT 10–103254) soveltuvin osin sekä tietosuoja- ja salassapitoliite. Toimeksiannossa noudatetaan KSE 2013 ehtoja soveltuvin osin, ks. tilaajien esittämät liitteessä poikkeamat KSE 2013 ehdoista. Tilaajat varaavat mahdollisuuden tarkentaa ja täydentää poikkeamia koskevaa listausta tulevaan sopimusneuvotteluun. Tarvittavat kokoukset hankkeen eri vaiheissa sisältyvät tulevaan toimeksiantoon. Kokoukset täsmennetään tehtäväluettelojen mukaisesti sopimusneuvotteluvaiheessa. Hankkeessa käytetään projektipankkia, johon kaikki tuotetut dokumentit tallennetaan projektipankissa olevan ohjeistuksen mukaisesti. Hanke suunnitellaan tietomallipohjaisesti. Joukkoliikenneterminaalihankkeen edistäminen on ehdollinen sille, että tilaajat saavat tarvittavat päätökset hankkeen edistämiseen.,

Q702--North Kansas City OPC Initial Outfitting Transition Activation Contract
description: Department of Veterans Affairs Veterans Health Administration Program Contracting Activity Central (PCAC) November 4, 2026 PRESOLICITATION NOTICE Initial Outfitting, Transition, and Activation Services in support of the North Kansas OPC 100% SDVOSB SET ASIDE This is a Pre-Solicitation Notice that the Veterans Health Administration (VHA) intends to solicit quotes to provide non-personal Initial Outfitting, Transition, and Activation (IOT&A) services for the North Kansas Outpatient Clinic (OPC). This requirement supports VHA's mission by providing contractor support services to help bring the hospital into full planned operations that will provide health care services to Veterans. This will be a firm-fixed-price contract with an estimated Period of Performance of 38-months. This project proposes to lease an approximately 102,736 NUSF replacement and expanded Outpatient Clinic in the vicinity of Kansas City, MO, including 700 parking spaces. The new facility allows for decompression of the Kansas City VAMC. The lease would allow VA to enhance outpatient services by closing space gaps identified in the SCIP process. The new lease would expand the current Primary Care space, allowing for the full implementation of the PACT model of care delivery, improving operational efficiencies and the Veteran experience. The newly leased right-sized, state-of-the-art, energy-efficient health care facility would provide Primary Care, Mental Health, Specialty Care, Outpatient Surgery and Ancillary services to Veterans in the Kansas City area. The scope includes project support for planning, activating, outfitting, and transitioning the staff and Veterans/patients associated with the project. The scope of services includes Comprehensive Project Management, Comprehensive Interior Design, FF&E, and Space Planning Support; CONOPS and Transitioning Planning; Acquisition Support Services to include package development, Activation, Delivery, Relocation and Installation, Training, and Turnover and Post Occupancy Support for the identified project. This requirement will be set-aside 100% for Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Businesses (SDVOSBs) using FAR Part 12 and 37. To be eligible for an SDVOSB set aside under VA s Veterans First Contracting Program, SDVOSBs must: be verified by the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) as SDVOSB (see https://search.certifications.sba.gov/ for details) and meet the small business size standard for NAICS 541614. The solicitation is anticipated to be posted on Contract Opportunities for download on or about 19 November 2026. Potential offerors are advised that there may be truncated response time on the solicitation that will follow this Pre-Solicitation notice. Anticipated closing date of the solicitation will be 18 December 2026. Solicitation initial posting date and the closing date are subject to change as necessary. Any questions for this Pre-solicitation notice should be sent via e-mail to both Katherine.Johnson6@va.gov and Kathleen.Klotzbach@va.gov. No telephone requests/questions will be accepted. This Pre-Solicitation notice does not constitute a request for proposals. P.O.C: Katherine.Johnson6@va.gov, Contract Specialist and Kathleen.Klotzbach@va.gov, Contracting Officer

title: Human Portable RNID Devices CT FEMA
description: REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) SUMMARY: The Department of Homeland Security (DHS), Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA), Chemical Biological Radiological Nuclear Test and Evaluation Division (CBRN T&E), require assistance in understanding the current state of human portable RN ID devices. GENERAL INFORMATION: This RFI is issued solely for information gathering purposes to identify sources that can provide support for the CBRN T&E Komodo Dragon Characterization Test (KD CT) event. In accordance with FAR 15.101(c), RFIs may be used when the Government wants to obtain price, delivery, other market information, and capabilities for planning purposes. Responses to these RFIs are not offers and cannot be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract. This RFI shall not be construed as a commitment by the Government for any purpose, nor does it restrict the Government to an ultimate acquisition approach. Respondents are solely responsible for all expenses associated with their RFI response. Respondents will not receive additional information in response to their submittal to the RFI and will not be notified of the resulting market research. PROPRIETARY INFORMATION AND DISCLAIMERS: Respondents shall identify any proprietary information in its RFI response. Information submitted in response to this RFI will be used at the discretion of the Government. Further, the information submitted will remain confidential insofar as permitted by law, including the Freedom of Information and Privacy Acts. FEMA reserves the right to utilize any non-proprietary technical information in the anticipated PWS or solicitation. Although it is not necessary to address in their response, respondents shall be aware of any potential, actual, or perceived organizational conflicts of interest. Any real or potential conflicts must be sufficiently mitigated prior to a contract award. For further guidance, refer to the Federal Acquisition Regulation, Part 9.5. KD CT, will include Replicative Assessment of Spectrometric Equipment (RASE) and will give preference to vendors/devices with replay tools[1], incorporate a cyber security assessment, and start in the 2nd quarter of FY27. Additional RASE information is available on GitHub at https://github.com/LLNL/RASE#readme-ov-file. It should be noted by vendors that CBRN T&E plans to use injected data with the replay tool. Vendors should note there will be environmental and potentially destructive tests conducted during KD CT. For the cybersecurity assessment, CBRN T&E will request copies (binary) of all communication software and mobile device applications used to configure, operate, or provide reachback/transmit detector information. Cyber testing will also include a vendor questionnaire to establish the baseline cybersecurity posture of the device(s) along with technical interchange meetings (TIMs) to clarify responses. Where applicable, CBRN T&E will perform a cooperative vulnerability penetration assessment on the device(s). CBRN T&E will also request a Software Bill Of Materials (SBOM) to establish supply chain risk/vulnerabilities associated with the supporting software developed for the SUT operations. The final KD products will inform FEMA�s and other FSLTT agencies� future procurement of human portable RN ID devices and address requests from front line operators. title: FEMA Request for Information - Direct Housing Modernization Capabilities
description: This Request for Information (RFI) is issued in accordance with Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulations Overhaul (RFO) 15.101(c). This RFI does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP), Invitation for Bid (IFB), or Request for Quotation (RFQ), and it is not to be construed as a commitment by the Government to enter into a contract, nor will the Government pay for the information submitted in response to this request. All information contained in this RFI is preliminary and is subject to change if, and when, a solicitation is issued. Responses to this notice are not offers and cannot be accepted by the U.S. Government to form a binding contract. If a competitive solicitation is released, it will be synopsized on the System for Award Management (SAM.gov) website. It is the responsibility of the interested parties to monitor this site for additional information pertaining to this RFI, or future solicitations. The Department of Homeland Security, Federal Emergency Management Agency, Office of Direct Housing Operations, is conducting market research to identify and seek capabilities from industry in five primary functional areas: Automated Real Estate Aggregation and Vacancy Sourcing - Automated discovery and ingestion of residential rental property listings via Multiple Listing Services (MLS), property management software APIs, commercial rental boards, and direct landlord entry portals. - Real-time vacancy validation to prevent matching against obsolete or unavailable listings. - Rapid geo-fencing within disaster-declared zones and surrounding reasonable-commute perimeters. Artificial Intelligence and Algorithmic Matching - Multi-constraint matching algorithms that pair applicant household profiles with available properties in seconds. - Multi-point geospatial proximity optimization factoring in school district retention, work commutes, medical/provider travel distance, and essential services. - Household composition sizing aligned with HUD Housing Quality Standards (HQS) and FEMA occupancy guidelines. Automated Physical Accessibility Verification - Algorithmic filtering and computer vision inspection tools capable of evaluating floor plans, entry photos, and property specifications against UFAS and ADA physical accessibility standards. - Rapid identification of barrier-free environments, ramps, ground-floor units, grab bars, and wheelchair-accessible kitchens and bathrooms. Landlord Engagement and Leasing Workflow Automation - Automated outreach tools and self-service portals for landlords to submit properties, accept lease terms, and coordinate inspections. - Integration with standard government lease templates and automated electronic signature workflows. Secure Federal Architecture - Enterprise data security architecture compliant with the Federal Information Security Modernization Act (FISMA) at the Moderate impact baseline. - FedRAMP-authorized cloud hosting (or capability to achieve FedRAMP Moderate/High authorization). - Strict data protection for Sensitive Personally Identifiable Information (PII) belonging to disaster survivors. NAICS CODE: 541512 (Computer Systems Design Services) / 531210 (Offices of Real Estate Agents and Brokers) PRODUCT SERVICE CODE (PSC): X1FA, Lease/Rental of Family Housing Facilities ANTICIPATED PERIOD OF PERFORMANCE START DATE: TBD RFI RESPONSE SUBMITTAL INSTRUCTIONS: Interested contractors shall submit Questions and RFI responses electronically to the Contracting Officer, at Rachel.Woods@fema.dhs.gov no later than 12:00PM Eastern Time (ET), December 18, 2026. Phone calls will not be accepted. Please see the attachment for further instructions and information.

title: Atomically Precise Molecules (APM)
description: The Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) is soliciting innovative proposals in the areas of new synthesis techniques for polymeric materials and nonlinear optical (NLO) materials. Proposed research should investigate innovative approaches that enable revolutionary advances in material synthesis with the ability to scale to quantities relevant for application integration, culminating in the development of a prototype demonstration of a revolutionary NLO material integrated into a functional government-provided electro-optic modulator. Specifically excluded is research that primarily results in evolutionary improvements to the existing state of practice, or research that pivots on exceptional claims that cannot be technically justified in the proposal. This includes: � Proposals aiming to employ solely inorganic materials without a polymeric component � Proposals aiming to modify/repurpose existing NLO materials resulting in incremental improvements to the state-of-the-art (SoA)

title: KAUTZ ROAD SUBSTATION CONSTRUCION, UIP SUBPROJECT 2- KRS
description: This scope of work is to rebuild and renovate the Kautz Road Substation (KRS), which is UIP subproject SP-2. The KRS supplies electricity to various lab buildings and systems. These systems serve both conventional facility needs, as well as process utility requirements. It is vital to Fermilab�s mission that KRS be revitalized and expanded, ensuring the ability to serve existing and future loads. The General contractor shall furnish all required supervision, labor, materials, tools, plant and appurtenances necessary to perform diligently and fully all work as described in the drawings and technical specifications. All work includes transportation, overhead, bonding costs, safety oversight, quality control oversight, and supervision as required to construct the project described in the drawings, technical specification and the detailed description contained herein. The critical schedule constraint for construction of this project is Fermilab�s accelerator shutdown, with an anticipated scheduled start on January 1, 2028, and anticipated end date of January 1, 2030- these dates may change depending on the needs of the Lab. The General Contractor must start their on-site efforts, and complete the construction scope under this contract, within the shutdown window. This project includes the following milestones: Milestone 1 � 60 Calendar Days after issuance of Notice to Proceed (NTP). This milestone is intended for completion of necessary submittals and RFIs, approval of shop drawings for fabrication and procurement. Milestone 2 � 4th January 2028; This milestone marks the point where access is permitted inside Kautz Road Substation yard and construction work may begin. Milestone 3 � 31st of March 2028; This milestone marks the completion of building foundation and ready for placement of the new prefabricated control house building (provided by FermiForward). Milestone 4 � 2nd July 2029; This milestone marks the formal issuance of an Authorization for Use and Possession (AUP) of the KRS Substation facility, including all remedial work following removal of site trailers, but not including seasonal work and all final punch list items addressed.. Milestone 5 � 30th September 2029; This milestone marks the completion of the project.

description: The aim is to implement the Federal Administration's cloud strategy of 11 December 2020 (SB020 – Federal Cloud Strategy). A total of five awards will be made (two each for lots 1 and 2, and one for lot 3), each to a different tenderer, for the acquisition of the cloud services and related goods/services put out to tender here. title: Strategic Technology Office-wide Innovation Solutions Opening Announcement
description: The Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) anticipates funding a limited number of proposals under this solicitation. Specifically excluded is research that primarily results in evolutionary improvements to the existing state of practice. Proposed research should investigate innovative approaches that enable revolutionary advances in science, devices, or systems. The Strategic Technology Office (STO) at DARPA regularly publishes solicitations requesting responses to specific program topics. This announcement seeks revolutionary research ideas for topics not addressed by ongoing STO programs or other published DARPA solicitations. To avoid proposals that duplicate existing activities or are responsive to other published STO solicitations, potential proposers are highly encouraged to review current STO programs and solicitations, respectively listed at http://www.darpa.mil/about-us/offices/sto and http://www.darpa.mil/work-with-us/opportunities. Contacting STO program managers to discuss their research interests is also encouraged. A current list of program managers is available at http://www.darpa.mil/about-us/people. This Innovation Solutions Opening solicits under the procurement authorities of 10 U.S. Code � 4001, 10 U.S.C. � 4021, 10 U.S.C. � 4022, and 10 U.S.C. � 4023, that allow procurement activities authority to enter into agreements with industry, academia, and other organizations to fund research and development through cooperative agreements, Other Transaction Agreements (OTAs) for research, OTAs for prototypes, and procurement for experimental purposes. Proposals received as a result of this Innovation Solutions Opening will be evaluated by the Government in accordance with the evaluation criteria specified herein through a scientific review process. DARPA solicitations are posted on the SAM website under the Contract Opportunities link at https://sam.gov/. The following information is for those wishing to respond to the Innovation Solutions Opening. 1.1. STO MISSION AND THRUST AREAS DARPA's STO is a systems warfare office that seeks innovative and disruptive technologies for existing and future battlespaces. STO programs deliver solutions at speed and scale for today's warfighters while developing the resilient "breakthrough" systems and technologies across all physical domains (Air, Space, Sea, and Land) and across the spectrum of competition. STO does not focus on one area of responsibility or phenomenology. Instead, STO programs capture the strategic, logistical, and tactical complexity of today's national security environments. STO seeks to create new "proof-of-concept" mission systems. 1.2. TOPIC AREAS OF INTEREST Research areas of current interest to STO include, but are not limited to, the following topics: � Acoustic communication and sensing � Adaptability � Advanced computing � Additive manufacturing � Architecture and advanced systems engineering � Artificial intelligence � Autonomy and control algorithms � Combat identification � Command and control (C2) � Communications and networking, virtual and adaptive � Complexity management � Critical infrastructure defense � Decision aids and C2 technology � DevOps and novel software development and integration � Directed energy (DE) � Distributed autonomy and teaming (machine-machine, human-machine) � Economic security � Effects chain functions (disaggregated find, fix, track, target, engage, assess) � Electro-optic/infrared sensors � Electromagnetic warfare (EW) � High-frequency (HF) communications and sensing � High voltage electric power systems and architecture � Human behavior modeling � Human-machine symbiosis � Industrial engineering � Integration and reliability technologies � Interoperability � Logistics � Modeling and simulation � Microwave and millimeter wave communications and sensing � Novel kinetic effects � Non-kinetic effects (EW, DE, cyber) � Optical technologies � Photonics � Radio technologies (especially software-defined and novel waveforms and processing) � Radar and adaptive arrays � Resilient systems � Robotics � Seekers and other expendable sensors and processing � Sensors and analytics � Signal processing � Space sensors, communications, autonomy, and architectures (especially supporting proliferated low earth orbit constellations) � Strategy analysis technology � Supply chain analytics � System of systems � Undersea and seabed technology � Tactics development technology � Testing and data collection � Very low earth orbit (VLEO) technology � Very low frequency (VLF) technology

title: Large Component Blast Booth, 309 Aerospace Maintenance and Regeneration Group (AMARG), Davis-Monthan AFB, AZ 85707
description: DESCRIPTION: This is a Source Sought Notice Only- The Aerospace Maintenance and Regeneration Group (AMARG), Davis-Monthan AFB, AZ, requires a Large Component Blast Booth. This requirement is not currently anticipated to be solicited on a small business set-aside basis. However, a set aside will be contemplated, provided 2 or more quali?ed small business respond to this sources sought synopsis with information sufficient to support a set-aside. Be advised that the U.S. Government will not be able to set aside this requirement if 2 or more small businesses do not respond with information to support the set-aside. We encourage all small businesses, in all socioeconomic categories (including, 8(a) Business Development Program, Small Disadvantage Business, Historically Underutilized Business Zone, Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned, Women- Owned Small Business concerns), to identify their capabilities in meeting the requirement at a fair market price. This notice is issued solely for information and planning purposes - it does not constitute a Request for Quote (RFQ)/Invitation for Bid (IFB)/Request for Proposal (RFP) or a promise to issue an RFQ, IFB or RFP in the future. This notice does not commit the U.S. Government to contract for any supply or service. Further, the U.S. Government is not seeking quotes, bids or proposals at this time and will not accept unsolicited proposals in response to this sources sought notice. The U.S. Government will not pay for any information or administrative costs incurred in response to this notice. Submittals will not be returned to the responder. Not responding to this notice does not preclude participation in any future RFQ or IFB or RFP, if any is issued. If a solicitation is released, it will be synopsized on the Government wide Point of Entry. It is the responsibility of potential o?ers to monitor the Government wide Point of Entry for additional information pertaining to this requirement. The anticipated NAICS code is: 332311 Prefabricated Metal Building and Component Manufacturing. Size Standard: 750 Employees. The objective of this effort is to purchase a complete and Turn-Key design, construction, and installation of a new corrosion control facility at the 309th Aerospace Maintenance and Regeneration Group (AMARG), located within a controlled area of Davis-Monthan Air Force Base (DMAFB), Arizona. The primary function is the corrosion control of Aerospace Ground Equipment (AGE) and other ferrous related items. The media blast booth will be housed within a fully enclosed Pre-Engineered Metal Building (PEMB) that also provides a separated maintenance support operations area (MX Ops Area). The entire facility shall be constructed on a currently unimproved site located North of Building 7213 (the Small Paint Booth). The performing contractor is responsible for providing all management, professional services, labor, materials, and equipment to deliver a fully functional and operational facility. description: INTRODUCTION The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Veterans Health Administration (VHA), Program Contracting Activity Central (PCAC) anticipates soliciting proposals and subsequently awarding a single firm-fixed-price contract for the design-bid-build minor construction project #593-407, Diagnostic Imaging Center Expansion Minor Construction at VA Southern Nevada Healthcare System (VASNHS) located at 6900 North Pecos Rd., North Las Vegas, NV 89086. PROJECT DESCRIPTION The contractor shall provide all tools, equipment, materials, labor, supervision, and management to complete the construction of a new 2-story expansion and renovation to expand the Radiology Department and integrate with the Emergency Department. Construction practices shall comply with all VA solicitation drawings and specifications, VA regulations, procedures, and conditions for work at the medical center and any applicable codes as per requirements of all governing agencies. This project shall construct a new 2- story 11,282 square foot Diagnostic Imaging Center Expansion and renovate 870 square feet of an adjacent storage room and exam space in the Emergency Department to expand the Radiology Department and integrate the two spaces. The first floor will consist of a state-of-the-Art facility fully equipped for provisions or services to house (2) MRI, CT, X-ray, Ultrasound, Administrations and Support spaces to support the Radiology Department. The second floor will be an extension of the existing penthouse that services the Emergency Department. The project will include the relocation of existing utilities that encroach into the building footprint of the new expansion as shown on the design documents. Work includes general construction, alterations, and certain other items. Services include but not limited to furnish all supervision, labor, equipment, materials, and transportation necessary to accomplish work for the demolition and replacement as required by specifications and drawings. Contractor shall complete the intent of project 593-407 in strict accordance with the SOW, drawings, and specifications. All work not specifically identified by the drawings and/or specifications but necessary for a complete system shall be included as if specifically identified in the Contract Documents. ADMINISTRATIVE The solicitation will be issued as a Request for Proposals (RFP) conducted in accordance with FAR part 15 and will be evaluated in accordance with the tradeoff procedures listed in the solicitation. The solicitation will be issued as a total Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) set-aside. Offers received from other than SDVOSB concerns will not be considered. The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 236220 with a size standard of $45.0 million. The solicitation will be issued in late Nov 2026. The period of performance is approximately 480 calendar days from the issuance of the notice to proceed. In accordance with VAAR 836.204, the magnitude of construction is between $10,000,000 and $20,000,000. This notice is not a request for competitive offers. All questions must be submitted in writing to the issuing office via email to Jessica.stevenson3@va.gov. Telephone calls will not be accepted.

title: TECHNOLOGY LICENSING OPPORTUNITY: Heat Pipe Reactor Fire Mitigation and Suppression System
description: The Heat Pipe Reactor Fire Mitigation and Suppression System from Los Alamos National Laboratory, transforms the heat pipes inside an alkali metal-cooled nuclear reactor from passive thermal conduits into active, sensor-driven fire defense components, giving designers of advanced small and microreactors a layered, automated safeguard against one of the most challenging hazards in their systems. By combining an inert gas buffer, a phase change material jacket, automated suppressant injection at multiple points and optional neutron-absorber dispersion into the reactor core, the system delivers redundant protection that responds within milliseconds of detecting fire-like conditions. This system enables advanced reactor developers to meet stringent safety expectations for remote, unattended and space-constrained deployments without redesigning the core architecture around bulky external suppression equipment. How it Works During normal operation, each heat pipe carries thermal energy away from the reactor core through the evaporation and condensation of an alkali metal working fluid, while valves connecting the heat pipe to external suppressant chambers remain closed. Temperature and pressure sensors continuously monitor the heat pipe reactor core and the valves near each heat pipe end, feeding data to a controller that compares readings against predefined thresholds. When a reading crosses the first threshold, the controller opens a valve and forces a fire suppressant material, typically a boron compound, into the interior of the heat pipe. If conditions worsen and a second threshold is crossed, additional valves activate to inject suppressant from the opposite end of the heat pipe, evacuate the working fluid through a dedicated valve and release suppressant into an inert gas chamber that annularly surrounds the heat pipe at the heat exchanger interface. Technical Description The system architecture centers on a heat pipe reactor core engaging a plurality of dual-ended or single-ended heat pipes, where both ends of each heat pipe extend externally of the core block so that suppressant can be introduced from either side of the core. A heat exchanger device sits at the heat rejection end of each heat pipe and defines an enclosed inert gas chamber that annularly surrounds the heat pipe, creating a physical gap between the alkali metal working fluid and any water-based cooling fluid. The chamber adds a second point of failure that must occur before incompatible fluids can interact, and the inert gas itself can serve as a blanketing agent for active flames. A layer of phase change material, typically a salt that doubles as a Class D fire extinguishing agent and alkali metal fire retardant, is disposed on the outer surface of the gas chamber, partitioned by fin-bearing components that both store thermal energy and improve heat transfer to the surrounding cooling fluid. The active suppression and shutdown logic is governed by a controller comprising memory, processor, input/output circuitry and communications circuitry, optionally implemented as a distributed or cloud-based system. First and second valves regulate suppressant flow into each end of the heat pipe interior cavity from dedicated suppressant chambers, while third and fourth valves regulate suppressant flow into the inert gas chamber from separate chambers. The second valve at the heat pipe�s far end can also be configured to evacuate working fluid either simultaneously with or prior to suppressant injection, encouraging dispersion of the suppressant throughout the pipe. As an additional shutdown pathway, the reactor core block can include gaps between fuel rods and heat pipes in which a neutron absorber material such as cadmium or a boron compound is preloaded; on detection of an alkali metal fire, the controller can release that absorber into the gaps to reduce core reactivity and aid shutdown, providing a coupled fire-and-reactivity response unique to this design. Advantages Multiple independent barriers between reactive alkali metals and potential ignition sources, reducing the probability of a single-point failure Automated, sensor-driven response that opens valves and injects suppressant within milliseconds of fire-like conditions being detected Dual-purpose phase change jacket that stores thermal energy during normal operation and acts as a fire retardant during an event Coupled fire suppression and reactor shutdown through optional neutron absorber dispersion into the core Flexible architecture compatible with both heat pipe-cooled reactor cores and auxiliary equipment such as molten salt pumps Configurable suppressant choices and threshold logic, allowing developers to tailor the response to their specific reactor design Market Applications Nuclear Energy (microreactors, small modular reactors, heat pipe-cooled designs) Power Generation (remote bases, mining sites, Arctic installations) Space and Lunar Surface Power (radioisotope and fission surface power systems) Industrial Process Heat (high-temperature manufacturing, hydrogen production facilities) Marine and Naval Propulsion (advanced compact reactor concepts for maritime use) Nuclear Safety Instrumentation (sensor and controller subsystems for licensed reactor operators) Development Status: TRL 3 U.S. Patent No. 12,640,276 LA-UR-26-25100 LANL Tech Partnerships: Unlock the Innovative Potential Los Alamos National Laboratory offers a wide range of cutting-edge technologies and capabilities that may provide your company with a competitive edge in the market and unlock the innovative potential that can enhance, refine, and revolutionize your products. LANL�s licensing program focuses on moving inventions developed by our researchers to commercial innovations. Patented and patent pending inventions and copyrighted software are available to existing and start-up companies through exclusive and non-exclusive licensing agreements. For specific discussions, please contact licensing@lanl.gov. title: INTERNATIONAL COMMERCIAL TRADE INFORMTAION SUBSCRIPTION SERVICE
description: The CBSA is seeking input from industry on the following: Specific products offered as an online subscription service that provides access to tools that support the international commercial trade environment (i.e. databases and tools that simplify trade compliance, duty calculations, and tax obligations) with specific access required to the World Customs Organization (WCO) Harmonized System (HS) Explanatory Notes and Compendium of Classification Opinions (official, non-legally binding administrative tools used to interpret and apply the international HS nomenclature). The CBSA intends to use input to help determine the “way forward” as to whether and how this service should be acquired, delivered, and managed and if so, to solidify its procurement approach. The purpose of this Request for Information (RFI) is to develop a better understanding of the capabilities and maturity of industry with respect to the ability of the private sector to provide goods and/or services to the CBSA.

title: Agrandissement et rénovation du centre d'enseignement secondaire supérieur de Wiedlisbach (OZW)
description:
Le groupement scolaire de Wiedlisbach gère le centre d'enseignement secondaire (OZW) pour les communes de Wiedlisbach, Oberbipp, Attiswil, Rumisberg et Farnern. En raison de l'augmentation des effectifs scolaires, il existe un besoin supplémentaire en locaux scolaires. Parallèlement, les 

bâtiments scolaires existants nécessitent des adaptations sur les plans architectural, énergétique et fonctionnel.

Le projet comprend la rénovation du bâtiment scolaire datant de 1958 et l’agrandissement des anciens gymnases adjacents.

La procédure de sélection des concepteurs vise à désigner une équipe de conception appropriée en tant que maître d’œuvre (selon la norme SIA 102) pour la conception et la réalisation (phases SIA 31 à 53).

title: Netherlands – Software-related services – SaaS-ICT-oplossing voor Burgerzaken, gemeente Voorst-2026
description: Gemeente Voorst besteedt vanwege het aflopen van de huidige overeenkomst via een openbare Europese procedure nieuwe een SaaS-ICT-oplossing voor Burgerzaken aan. De opdracht omvat de levering, implementatie en het gebruik van een integrale SaaS-oplossing, inclusief conversie, koppelingen, technisch beheer, onderhoud en support. De gemeente sluit hiervoor één overeenkomst met één opdrachtnemer, die gedurende de gehele looptijd als centraal aanspreekpunt fungeert. De overeenkomst heeft een initiële looptijd van vijf jaar en kan vijfmaal met twee jaar worden verlengd, tot maximaal vijftien jaar. De beoogde ingangsdatum is uiterlijk 15 februari 2027. De gunning vindt plaats op basis van de beste prijs-kwaliteitverhouding, waarbij prijs voor 20% en kwaliteit voor 80% meetelt.
